notes: Ibn Abbas is read as the last link because his words («فقال ألا تعجبون») are the saying (rule 6); he is named inside a scene («دخلنا على ابن عباس»), the rule 11 case: is he the source or only a person in it?
«أخبرني» before Ibn Abi Mulayka is a transmission verb

fixes.reason: K6I's index stops at Ibn Abi Mulayka; the text relays Ibn Abbas's words as the saying and RWY carries him as the last link.
